subject.title: Feature Request: Support YAML as config file format

question: Should OpenClaw add YAML/YML as a supported core config file format, or keep JSON5 `openclaw.json` plus CLI/RPC config mutation as the only core config-file contract?
rationale: The request expands the core config-file contract and touches compatibility-sensitive parsing, path precedence, write-back, reload, and docs behavior; current code and policy do not make that choice for automation.

options.title: Keep JSON5 canonical
options.body: Reaffirm `openclaw.json` as the only core config file and steer scripted edits through `openclaw config` or `config.patch`.

options.title: Approve YAML contract
options.body: Require a design and PR that defines `.yaml`/`.yml` precedence, parser semantics, write-back behavior, reload/doctor coverage, docs, and upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Keep JSON5 canonical
recommendation.body: Reaffirm `openclaw.json` as the only core config file and steer scripted edits through `openclaw config` or `config.patch`.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the config contract, docs, and compatibility-sensitive config IO paths.
